name: tools-address-tracker-v5-0
title: Address tracker v5.0.6
description:
This is a javascript tool (which can be run on a browser) I made to help with tracking used addresses (specifically RAM addresses) when installing ASM resources (patches, blocks, sprites, uberasm tool, etc.).

Techinically, this is open source since JS as an interpreted language.

Features include sorting them, displaying the gap between two addresses, and if there are two or more entries conflicting (“overlap”). The last one is very useful if you happen to have an ASM resource bugging out when 2+ resources happen to use the same RAM for different purposes.

Another tool is that it automatically gives RAM to each freeram define (assigning) the asm resource requires.

This is certainly useful for collaboration hacks to visualize the RAMs being used in a compact user-friendly way.

Changelog
2025-05-25 v5.0.4

	-Fixed a problem with Assigner that due to a greedy first hit

	 algorithm, results in a failed assigned address that should be a

	 success. This occurs if you have a define with a shorter RAM,

	 then a longer one on the defines list, and the empty RAM list

	 to have a lower-address gap being longer than the high-address

	 gap, as pointed out by Atari2.0.

	-All inputs entries now allow spaces instead of just tabs

	 separating addresses, number of bytes, and min and max address

	 (for assigner). This also means that the ASM resource name no

	 longer accepts spaces in its name.

	-Made the HTML files more pleasnt to read:

	--No sharp contrasting white-text-on-black-background

	--Some blocks of text on the 2 tools are now contained within

	  HTML details tag.

	-Addresser now accepts freeram list having both the min and max

	 addresses omitted for user friendliness.

	-Added a percentage and a progress bar for Assigner.html showing

	 how much of all available bytes are taken.

	-You can now double-click on code displays (in "pre" HTML tags)

	 to easily select the entire thing to copy it.

	-All HTMLs are now linked to each other for ease of use.

-Fixed a slight visual error caused by when the message "There are
define(s) failed to assigned and they are not counted as
consuming RAM." causes a slight vertical height changes in that
area.
-Fixed the progress bar having an odd pixel on the left edge and a
slight subpixel color on where the fill edge meets the empty
part. This is due to some browser rendering error (tested on
chrome v137.0.7151.41). This is now moved to a separate HTML
element.
--As an addition, I added color indicator that turns yellow
when 50-75 percent and red when 75 or more percent.
Github: https://github.com/GhbSmwc/SMW_Addressmapper
